sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities. sources.title: [2511.21631] Qwen3-VL Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We introduce Qwen3-VL, the most capable vision-language model in the Qwen series to date, achieving superior performance across a broad range of multimodal benchmarks. It natively supports interleaved contexts of up to 256K tokens, seamlessly integrating text, images, and video. sources.snippet: On 28 April 2025, the Qwen3 model family was released, [31] with all models licensed under the Apache 2.0 license. The Qwen3 model family includes both dense and MoE models.
